q.en: "Doctors made an early ___ after running several tests."
q.bn: "Doctors made an early ___ after running several tests."

why.en: "Diagnosis" is the noun form, needed here after "an early".
why.bn: "Diagnosis" noun form, "an early"-এর পরে এটাই লাগবে।

q.en: "A ___ lifestyle significantly increases the risk of heart disease."
q.bn: "A ___ lifestyle significantly increases the risk of heart disease."

why.en: "Sedentary" describes a lifestyle involving little physical activity, which raises heart disease risk.
why.bn: "Sedentary" মানে কম physical activity-যুক্ত lifestyle, যা heart disease-এর risk বাড়ায়।

q.en: Which pair contrasts stopping illness before it happens with treating it afterward?
q.bn: কোন pair অসুখ হওয়ার আগে থামানো আর পরে treat করার মধ্যে contrast দেখায়?

why.en: "Preventive" care stops illness before it happens; "curative" care treats it after it has occurred.
why.bn: "Preventive" care অসুখ হওয়ার আগে থামায়; "curative" care হয়ে যাওয়ার পরে treat করে।

q.en: "Washing hands regularly is one of the simplest ___ measures."
q.bn: "Washing hands regularly is one of the simplest ___ measures."

why.en: "Preventive measures" is the fixed collocation for actions taken to stop illness before it occurs.
why.bn: "Preventive measures" fixed collocation, অসুখ হওয়ার আগে নেওয়া পদক্ষেপের জন্য।

q.en: Which is a short-term, sudden illness, as opposed to a long-lasting one?
q.bn: কোনটা একটা short-term, sudden illness, long-lasting-এর বিপরীতে?

why.en: "Acute" illness is sudden and short-term, while "chronic" illness is long-lasting or recurring.
why.bn: "Acute" illness sudden এবং short-term, আর "chronic" illness long-lasting বা recurring।
